notes: Printed: 'Whenever one or more tokens you control enter, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature.' Raise the Alarm creates two Soldiers at once: one event (CR 603.2c, one instruction's tokens), so the Champion triggers once and gets that many, 2 counters (2/2 -> 4/4). Ferocious Pup's own effect then makes one Wolf: a second event, a second trigger, a third counter (5/5). On the base (30fabc4a) the sentence did not compile (a needs-atom record): no counter.
